0.long_answer: Microsporidiosis is an opportunistic infection that primarily occurs in patients with advanced immunodeficiency. In HIV-infected individuals, the risk for microsporidiosis increases notably when CD4+ T cell counts drop below 150 cells per cubic millimeter. This specific level of CD4+ T cell decline, characteristic of AIDS, significantly impairs the immune response and predisposes patients to opportunistic infections such as microsporidiosis.
0.short_answer: acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) with CD4+ T cell counts below 150 cells/mm3
